title: Love Is a Piece of Cake
description: Jessie Dale loves her bakery more than anything in the world. When developers threaten to force her out, she has to save it - and juggle a romance.

description: High school teacher Lauren stands to lose her career, and custody of her daughter, after a vengeful student turns her life upside down by falsely claiming he had an affair with her.

description: A woman is overcome with joy when her daughter, Zoe, returns to her after being abducted 17 years before. But is Zoe really her long-lost child?
